    df = pd.read_csv('data/environment/input/wollaston_beach_datasheet.csv', header=None)

    # Row 0: Title
    # Row 1: Location headers (Milton Road, Channing Street, Sachem Street, Rice Road)
    # Row 2: Tags (Date, 1-Day Rain, 2-Day Rain, 3-Day Rain, Enterococcus, ...)
    # Rows 3+: Data

    # Read the actual data starting from row 3 (skip title and headers)
    data_rows = []
    for idx in range(3, len(df)):
        row = df.iloc[idx]
        date = row[0]
        if pd.isna(date) or date == '':
            continue
        
        # Each location occupies 2 columns: rainfall (3-day) and enterococcus
        # Column 1: 1-day rain (Milton Road)
        # Column 2: 2-day rain (Milton Road) 
        # Column 3: 3-day rain (Milton Road)
        # Column 4: Enterococcus tag/value (Milton Road)
        # Column 5: Enterococcus value (Milton Road)
        # Columns repeat for Channing Street, Sachem Street, Rice Road

            base_col = 1 + loc_idx * 2

                'Rain_3day': rain_3day,
                'Entero_Tag': tag,
                'Entero_Value': val
            })
